name: IB Business Mgmt: Orrenmere
subtitle: IB Business SL/HL labs, mocks
shortDescription: Revise IB Business Management your way: adaptive quizzes, hands-on labs, guided real-world builds and timed mock papers.
longDescription:
IB Business Management revision with a personal study path that adapts to every answer you give.

Orrenmere covers every numbered topic of the IB Business management guide for first assessment 2024: Introduction to business management, Human resource management, Finance and accounts, Marketing, Operations management and the business management toolkit. HL-only topics and extensions are clearly marked, and one switch shows SL or HL.

### How It Helps
- Adaptive quizzes: your answers build a mastery map. The app chooses what to review next and links every missed question to a short lesson on the idea behind it.
- Two ways to study: follow the syllabus in IB unit order, or switch to Real-World and start from a business problem such as launching a start-up, surviving a cash crunch or winning customers.
- Original lessons with key points, worked examples, common mistakes and a real-world hook for every idea.
- Hands-on labs: break-even analysis, product life cycle, Ansoff and BCG matrices, Herzberg sorting and organization structures are free. Plus adds cash flow forecasts, investment appraisal, ratio analysis, stock control charts, pricing and elasticity, critical path analysis and decision trees.
- Guided builds: make decisions for a bakery, a design studio, a furniture maker and more, with calculations checked step by step.
- Timed mock papers in Paper 1, Paper 2 and HL Paper 3 style, with a review of every answer.
- IA studio: plan your business research project with a key concept lens, question starters, source checklist and a word budget.
- Exam skills: command terms and how the papers are built.
- Other boards: an optional, quiet map of where each topic sits in GCSE, A Level and AP Business.
- Coverage screen: see exactly how each topic of the guide maps to ideas and questions.

### Built for Real Study
- Original questions with worked reasoning, including calculation questions whose answers are checked by code.
- Text size from 50% to 300%, a layout that uses the full screen on phones and tablets, and everything works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
